scope: Isolated runtime processes; no LaunchAgent installation; generated data and loopback only.

cases.name: live_monitor_epoch
cases.detail: A current monitor emits coverage at or after the supervisor monitor-start epoch.

cases.name: private_runtime_files
cases.detail: Live evidence and status are private mode 0600.

cases.name: single_instance_lock
cases.detail: A second supervisor is refused without overwriting the first status.

cases.name: synthetic_probe_ready
cases.detail: Bundled probe opens the synthetic file and connects only to loopback.

cases.name: live_synthetic_file_peer_detection
cases.detail: Real monitor independently associates the probe identity, synthetic path and loopback peer; no upload claim.

cases.name: live_identity_and_ancestor_chain
cases.detail: The probe identity includes start time and its observed Python test parent appears in the ancestor chain.

cases.name: probe_completed
cases.detail: Probe exits normally after holding descriptors.

cases.name: configuration_reload_restarts_monitor
cases.detail: Changing saved configuration gracefully replaces the owned monitor with a fresh session.

cases.name: restart_archives_previous_evidence
cases.detail: The prior closed log is archived with a shutdown summary before a new log is opened.

cases.name: signal_shutdown_reaps_child
cases.detail: SIGTERM stops the supervisor and its owned monitor, reaps the child and publishes stopped.

cases.name: rotation_exit3_restart
cases.detail: Synthetic exit 3 repeatedly rotates and restarts; only five prior log archives remain.

cases.name: mock_shutdown_has_no_child
cases.detail: An owned synthetic child is also reaped on supervisor shutdown.

cases.name: bounded_failure_retry
cases.detail: Five synthetic failures trip the retry budget; the live supervisor reports failed without a monitor.

cases.name: failure_circuit_stays_open
cases.detail: Failure state does not immediately respawn another child.
